method: Source-only visual review. Primer pages identify diamond=mi, triangle=fa, oval=sol, square=law and show their ordinary hollow/filled forms. Enlarged probes are display-only native source pixels; no prediction or reference data consulted. Boxes are approximate native-pixel head bounds.

candidates.rationale: The enlarged filled square has a broad pale void and open outer contour across a substantial part of the body. This is not an ordinary counter for a filled square; the surviving square outline and staff placement support identity.
Enlargement resolves irregular pale breaks through the filled square body and a disrupted edge. Definite but visually smaller loss than the severe square at (338,571).
Multiple elongated pale breaks split the filled square body; loss affects a substantial fraction of expected solid ink. Not a normal hollow counter.

The oval's central opening is an ordinary hollow-note counter. The enlarged view suggests possible outer-contour loss, but the apparent opening/edge cannot be confidently separated from the unusual printed contour and staff overlap.
Probe shows only a cropped/overlapped fragment at this center; identity and damage cannot be judged safely.

The enlarged triangle consists of separated surviving regions with a missing connection/contour and substantial absent body. Primer's triangle is solid; its expected point and corners do not account for this gap.
A clear pale break interrupts the otherwise solid triangular body; the remaining shape is connected and more than a minor corner irregularity, but does not clearly reach the severe threshold.
Enlargement shows pale breaks through the filled body, but a connected recognizable triangular mass remains; damage is definite and appears below the severe body-loss threshold.
The enlarged solid diamond has a broad missing lower-left portion and a disrupted contour; loss is substantial. Its surviving pointed contour and staff placement support diamond identity.
This triangle's solid body and outline are continuous apart from ordinary triangular point/corner form and staff overlap. Do not label it damaged.

intact_controls.rationale: The small center opening is an ordinary hollow diamond counter; outline appears continuous.
Ordinary hollow oval with its expected counter; no definite source contour loss.
Ordinary hollow oval with intact outer contour and counter.
The apparent interior hole is the normal hollow-oval counter; no definite damage.

limitations: Only the provided labeled probes were reviewed. This does not establish first-three severe and first-three moderate heads per shape or first-two intact controls per shape across the page.
The oval at (743,585) remains ambiguous; ordinary hollow counters are excluded from damage counts.
